protocol: DashPal BLE protocol v1 golden vectors (docs/BLE_PROTOCOL.md). Byte-identical copy: RoadWise src/dashcam/__fixtures__/ble_vectors.json.
notes: hex: the exact bytes on the air, lowercase, no separators. dir: tx = dashcam -> phone (TX notify), rx = phone -> dashcam (RX write).
fields: every field after [type][ver] in wire order, little-endian; the reserved byte 'rsv' is not a field: written 0, ignored on read.
valid: encode(fields) == hex and decode(hex) == fields. decode_only: decode(hex) == fields (trailing bytes ignored, rsv ignored).
invalid: decode(hex) in direction dir is rejected with reason short | version | type (never a crash); the receiver counts it and drops it.
INFO has no [type][ver] header: its first byte is its own layout version (1). mac: 6 bytes MSB first, as lowercase hex; dashcam_id = mac; name = 'DashPal-' + last 2 bytes upper-case hex.
u64 values stay at or below 2^53 - 1 (JavaScript-safe).

valid.desc: STATUS monitoring, calibrated, primary, live, time synced
STATUS edge: cold chip, all flags, fps max
EVENT UNRESPONSIVE tier 3 audible, detail no_return_critical
EVENT edges: value min, duration saturated, unknown event id, not audible
ALERT glance warning routed to this phone
STATE nothing known: local time unknown, no ack yet
RESUME unknown boot, from the start
EVENT UNRESPONSIVE tier 3 audible, detail no_return (D4)
EVENT UNRESPONSIVE tier 3 audible, detail eyes_closed
EVENT CRITICAL_STAND_DOWN (ev 31) tier 0 log-only, detail face_gone
ALERT no-face warning routed to this phone

decode_only.desc: HELLO with 2 trailing bytes (20 bytes, the maximum a sender uses)
STATE with 6 trailing bytes (22 bytes: receivers do not enforce the 20-byte sender maximum)
EVENT with the reserved byte non-zero (ignored)
ALERT with the reserved byte non-zero (ignored)

invalid.desc: a phone->dashcam frame (STATE) received by the phone
a dashcam->phone frame (HELLO) received by the dashcam
a phone->dashcam frame (COMMAND) received by the phone

valid.desc: INFO out of the box: pairing window open, no bonds
valid.name: DashPal-9E01

valid.desc: INFO edges: 4 bonds, window open, version 255.255
valid.name: DashPal-FFFF

valid.desc: INFO window open, another phone is setting up (flags bit 1), no bonds
valid.name: DashPal-9E01

valid.desc: INFO Add another phone: one bond, window open, another phone is setting up
valid.name: DashPal-5678

notes: Link v2 (docs/BLE_PROTOCOL.md sections 2.2 and 3.3), from fixed inputs through tests/dp_phone.py (tools/make_auth_vectors.py).

Every hex is the exact bytes, lowercase. mac is INFO's 6 bytes, most significant first. A pairing's random values are given (a, b, nc, np, nd, id_p); the dashcam's Nc is the one INFO showed before the request.
code: S || check byte as Crockford base32, 28 characters (the last 4 padding bits zero), shown in 7 groups of 4.
sealed: [ctr u32 LE][AES-128-GCM][tag 16], nonce [dir][0 x 7][ctr u32 LE], aad [0x02][dir]; dir 1 dashcam -> phone (k_dp), 2 phone -> dashcam (k_pd); the keys are the session section's.
sealed_invalid: accepted = the counters the receiver had accepted before (its replay window); expect bad | replay | ok.

valid.desc: keyed, pairing window open, no phone
keyed, another phone holds the setup claim, one phone

sealed_invalid.desc: sealed with the other direction's key
63 behind the highest, not seen: accepted

notes: Link v3 (docs/BLE_PROTOCOL.md) from fixed inputs through tests/dp_phone.py (tools/make_auth_vectors.py).
v2.session, v2.sealed, v2.sealed_invalid, v2.x25519 apply unchanged to v3; v2.result's codes 0-4 and 7-9 too.
v2.code, v2.link, v2.pair, v2.add_phone and v2.info describe link v2 only; v2 is frozen (sha256 pinned).
schema/valid/invalid follow the top-level notes; a v3 codec knows the top-level schema plus this one.
pair.replace: prev_proof = HMAC(prev_K_pair, 'DPv3 replace' || mac || nc || id_p || prev_id || A || np)[0..16]; its relay entries carry that proof behind another A (and np): unproven, a new phone.
view: VIEW notifications, dir 3 under k_dp of session_after_pair.

valid.desc: another link holds the setup hold: 1 phone + the provisional one
an older board (link v2): update its firmware

relay.desc: the relay's own key pair behind the owner's prev_proof, the owner's Np
relay.expect: a new phone: the record of prev_id stays

relay.desc: the relay's own key pair and its own Np behind the owner's prev_proof
relay.expect: a new phone: the record of prev_id stays

valid.desc: AIM camera far to the right, yaw -127

invalid.desc: RX 0x88 (link v2's ADD_PHONE, unknown in v3)

sealed_invalid.desc: sealed in direction 1 (TX), opened as VIEW
